# hypersuite Contributor Agreement

Version 1.0 · 2026-10-26

You sign this agreement during the onboarding, before you get access to the
source code (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)).

This agreement is between **Namshubs, the hypersuite DAO** ("**we**"), and the
person signing below ("**you**"). Namshubs is not a registered legal entity
and has no postal address; for this agreement both parties treat it as one,
and it is reached at <https://github.com/namshubs/hypersuite/discussions>.
It applies to everything you submit to hypersuite.

## 1. Definitions

- "**Project**": hypersuite — its source code, documentation, build scripts
  and assets, on our development server and in the public releases.
- "**Contribution**": any work you submit to us for the Project — code,
  documentation, designs, tests, translations — by commit, patch, issue,
  message or any other way, unless you mark it "not a contribution" when you
  submit it.

## 2. Copyright license

You keep the copyright in your Contributions. You grant us a perpetual,
worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, irrevocable license to use,
reproduce, modify, prepare derivative works of, publicly display, distribute
and sublicense your Contributions, and to license them **under any terms,
including the Sustainable Use License and any later license of the Project**.

## 3. Patent license

You grant us and everyone who receives the Project from us a perpetual,
worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, irrevocable license under any patent
claims you can license that are necessarily infringed by your Contribution
alone or by its combination with the Project, to make, use, sell, offer for
sale, import and otherwise transfer the Project. If anyone sues claiming the
Project infringes a patent, the patent licenses they received under this
section end on the date the suit is filed.

## 4. Our commitments to you

In return:

a) Every version of the Project that contains your Contribution will be made
   available to its users free of charge for personal, non-commercial and
   internal business use, under the Sustainable Use License or under terms
   that are no more restrictive for those users (for example an OSI-approved
   open-source license).
b) We credit you in the changelog and an AUTHORS file, unless you ask us not
   to.

## 5. What you confirm

a) You are a natural person. Contributions come from you, not from an AI
   agent or bot acting on its own. Each Contribution is your own work, or you
   identify any part that is not (with its source and license).
b) You have the right to grant the licenses above. If an employer or client
   could claim rights in your Contributions, you have their written
   permission, or a written confirmation that they claim none.
c) You don't work for, contract for or represent a Big Tech platform company,
   and you tell us promptly if that changes.
d) You may use AI tools to write your Contributions. You have reviewed
   what you submit and are responsible for every line of it, as if you had
   written it yourself.
e) Your Contributions are provided "as is", without warranty, except for the
   confirmations in this section.

## 6. Confidentiality of the source code

The Project's source code and its history are not public. You agree to:

a) not publish, mirror or pass on any part of it that is not your own
   Contribution, except to us;
b) not upload it to services that keep it or may use it for training AI
   models. AI coding assistants are fine if their terms exclude training on
   your input;
c) keep your access credentials to yourself.

These duties last for five years after your access ends; they don't cover
anything we have published ourselves.

## 7. Personal rights

To the extent the applicable law allows, you agree not to assert moral or
personal rights (such as the right to object to modifications) against us
or the users of the Project in a way that prevents the uses licensed above.
Your credit under 4b is unaffected.

## 8. No obligation

We are not required to use or publish any Contribution. Either of us may
end the collaboration at any time; we then revoke your access. Sections 2,
3, 4, 6 and 7 continue after that.

## 9. Disputes

Questions and disputes about this agreement are raised with us at
<https://github.com/namshubs/hypersuite/discussions> (privately if you prefer: ask there for a private channel), and we
try to settle them there in good faith.
